products.title: Bestseller Duo Kit
products.description: Two of Skinofab's most-loved products, bundled into one unbeatable deal. This kit pairs our viral Color Changing Foundation with the Extreme Lip Plumper for a complete face look — adaptive coverage that matches your skin tone, plus plump, glossy lips in seconds. Everything you need, nothing you don't.

products.description: Mirror, mirror, on the wall, who's the fairest of them all? You of course! Take this compact beauty mirror everywhere with you to make sure your make-up always looks perfect.

products.title: Fibre Brow Gel
products.description: Thicker, fuller, defined brows — instantly. Skinofab's Fibre Brow Gel uses micro-fibre technology to coat and build each hair, creating a natural feathery finish that lasts all day. Waterproof and smudge-proof, it's the one product your brow routine has been missing. Available in 5 shades to match every hair colour.

products.title: Luxury Lip Liner
products.description: Give your plumped up lips extra definition and shape. Fill in uneven areas and make your lips more kissable than ever. Combine it with Volume Lip Gloss to give your lips a glossy finish.

products.title: Extreme Lip Plumper
products.description:
For an instant, extreme, effect

Feel the heat with our instant plumper for extreme results. Infused with powerful ingredients, our high-intensity lip serum provides instant, fiery plumping. Caution: this lip plumper delivers a tingling sensation and may feel hot on the lips.

products.title: Eyebrow Growth Serum
products.description: Achieve the fuller, thicker, and healthier brows you've always desired with our revolutionary Eyebrow Growth Serum. Our serum is expertly formulated to promote growth and strengthen each hair, and the skin around it, giving you bold and beautiful brows.

products.title: Eyelash Curler
products.description: This sleek eyelash curler is your secret weapon for captivating, wide-eyed allure. Compact and easy to use, it's perfect for creating stunning curls anytime, anywhere. Get ready to bat those lashes and turn heads wherever you go!

products.title: Eyelash Growth Serum
products.description: Achieve the fuller, thicker, and healthier lashes you've always desired with our revolutionary Eyelash Growth Serum. Our serum is expertly formulated to promote growth and strengthen each lash, and the skin around it, giving you bold and beautiful lashes.

products.title: Face Roller
products.description: Reveal your skin’s natural glow with our sleek stainless steel Face Roller — designed to refresh, de-puff, and revive your complexion. This cooling tool helps boost circulation and promote lymphatic drainage, leaving your skin looking smoother, firmer, and more radiant. Indulge in a relaxing ritual that enhances your beauty and brings a spa-like calm to your daily routine.

products.title: Gua Sha
products.description: Experience the smoother, more radiant skin you've always dreamed of with our innovative Gua Sha tool. Expertly crafted from stainless steel to enhance circulation and reduce puffiness, it provides you with a glowing complexion and a rejuvenated appearance. Enjoy the soothing effects and a flawless finish that highlights your natural beauty.

products.title: Normal Lip Plumper
products.description:
For longer lasting results

Lock in hydration with our long-lasting plumper, enriched with hydrating hyaluronic acid. For a long-lasting plump effect, apply regularly over time.

products.title: Lash & Brow Growth Kit
products.description: One kit. Longer lashes. Fuller brows. Skinofab's Lash & Brow Growth Kit combines our bestselling Eyelash Growth Serum and Eyebrow Growth Serum into a complete treatment duo — clinically inspired to visibly thicken and lengthen with consistent use. See results in as little as 4 weeks. Your transformation starts here.

products.title: Liquid Blender Brush
products.description: Flawless application, zero mess. Skinofab's Liquid Blender Brush is designed to apply liquid and cream products with salon-level precision — think seamless foundation blending, no streaks, no waste. The densely packed bristles pick up the perfect amount of product every time, giving you a smooth, even finish in half the time.

products.title: 2-in-1 Serum Mascara
products.description: Instantly achieve the look of longer, fuller lashes with our best-selling mascara. The ultra-smooth formula glides on without clumping, flaking, or smudging — and stays put all day, even through heat and humidity.

products.description: Smoother, brighter, firmer-looking skin. Our peptide serum pairs Argireline and Matrixyl with niacinamide and vitamin C to visibly soften fine lines.

products.title: Volume Lip Gloss
products.description: Discover the nourishing touch of our Shea Butter Lip Gloss. Infused with rich shea butter, this gloss hydrates and softens lips while adding a subtle sheen. Lightweight and non-sticky, it's perfect for daily wear and on-the-go touch-ups. Enjoy beautifully glossy lips with a natural look.
